meta.generated_by: a one-off survey of the window and font code (the measurements are cited per entry)
meta.units: pixels; max_px_per_line is the usable logical extent (end - x) of one line
meta.mirror_rule: logical pen unchanged; glyph drawn at x' = W - x - w. A line fits iff x + width <= x + max_px_per_line, i.e. x' >= 0 (u8 pen: overflow = missing glyph)
width_model: Latin width = sum of widths[byte] of the active font; letterSpacing is ignored unless {JPN} (src/text.c:1004-1010, 1957-1979)
renderer and GetStringWidth read the same tables (src/text.c:2207-2600); tables verified byte-for-byte against the English 2.0.6 ROM (pokehns.gba)
CHAR_KEYPAD_ICON (0xF8) xx uses the icon width 8/16/24 (src/text.c:94-112, 1549-1556)
{CLEAR n} adds n, {SKIP n} sets pen to x+n, {CLEAR_TO n} sets pen to max(pen, x+n) (src/text.c:1491-1518; GetStringWidth src/text.c:1913-1923)
{FONT n} switches the width table mid-string; {RESET_FONT} is a no-op in the renderer (src/text.c:1432-1437)

{MIN_LETTER_SPACING n}: GetStringWidth uses max(w, n); the renderer advances exactly n even for wider glyphs (u32 underflow + u8 pen, src/text.c:995-1003). Only union_room_chat.c uses it (src/union_room_chat.c:2882, 2906). There is NO forced small-font spacing as in FireRed.
newline advance = maxLetterHeight of the printer's template font, not of a {FONT} switch (src/text.c:1360-1362)
GetStringWidth returns 0 for any placeholder other than STR_VAR_1..3 (src/text.c:1848-1860): expand {PLAYER} etc. before measuring
GetStringWidth returns the widest line of a multi-line string (src/text.c:1843-1847, 1983-1985)

FONT_BOLD.note: Japanese only, no width function (src/text.c:75-90 has no FONT_BOLD entry)

overworld_dialogue.label: Overworld dialogue / msgbox (NPC text, scripts)
evidence: src/text.c:129-131 FONT_NORMAL maxLetterHeight 16 (2 lines in 32 px)
src/text.c:1175-1215 down arrow is 8x16 drawn at currentX
prompt_line_px 200: the 8x16 down arrow is drawn after the last glyph (src/text.c TextPrinterDrawDownArrow), inside the 208 px mirror width

multichoice.label: Script multichoice / dynamic multichoice menus
multichoice.window: auto: tiles = min(28, (w_max+9)/8 + 1), left shifted so left+tiles <= 28
multichoice.max_lines: one item per line (window height = 2*items tiles)
multichoice.byte_limit: 63 bytes per item after placeholder expansion (temp[64])
evidence: src/script_menu.c:1237-1242 width measured after StringExpandPlaceholders into u8 temp[64]
multichoice.notes: The window grows to fit, so the hard cap is 214 px (28 tiles). The practical budget is (28 - left)*8 - 10 px for the left coordinate the script passes; wider items push the menu left over other UI. Grid multichoice (src/script_menu.c:681-709) sizes each column the same way.
